high_level_description: This image is a digital infographic from an Instagram post by the account "investing_idea." The post is titled "RATIO CATEGORIES" and is designed to visually explain different financial ratios used in investment analysis. The infographic is divided into four main categories: Valuation, Profitability, Efficiency, and Liquidity. Valuation: Price to Earnings Ratios (P/E): Represented with a diamond icon. Price to Earnings to Growth Ratio (PEG): Also represented with a diamond icon. Dividend Yield/Payout Ratio: Represented with a gear
